timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.help: How long the probe will wait before giving up. Should be lower than your Prometheus scrape_timeout.

ca_file.label: CA file
ca_file.help: The CA cert to use for the targets (path inside the blackbox container).

cert_file.label: Client cert file
cert_file.help: The client cert file for the targets.

key_file.label: Client key file
key_file.help: The client key file for the targets.

server_name.label: Server name
server_name.help: Used to verify the hostname for the targets (SNI).

min_version.label: Min TLS version
min_version.help: Minimum acceptable TLS version. Go default is TLS 1.2.

max_version.label: Max TLS version
max_version.help: Maximum acceptable TLS version. Can be used to test for the presence of insecure TLS versions.

username_file.label: Username file
username_file.help: Read the username from a file (path inside the blackbox container).

password_file.label: Password file
password_file.help: Read the password from a file.

type.label: Type
type.help: Authentication type for the Authorization header. Default: Bearer.

credentials_file.label: Credentials file
credentials_file.help: Read credentials from a file. Mutually exclusive with credentials.

endpoint_params.label: Endpoint params
endpoint_params.help: Optional parameters to append to the token URL.

allow_missing.label: Allow missing
allow_missing.help: Do not fail if the header is absent.

value.label: Value
value.help: May reference groups captured by expect, such as ${1}.

expect.label: Expect (regex)
expect.help: Wait for a line matching this regex. Mutually exclusive with expect bytes.

expect_bytes.label: Expect bytes
expect_bytes.help: Exact byte-by-byte match. Mutually exclusive with expect.

send.label: Send
send.help: Content to send. May reference groups captured by expect, such as ${1}.

starttls.label: STARTTLS
starttls.help: Upgrade the connection to TLS at this step.

labels.label: Export labels
labels.help: Labels exported on the probe_expect_info metric.

expect.label: Expect (regex)
expect.help: Wait for a line matching this regex.

send.label: Send
send.help: Content to send. May reference groups captured by expect, such as ${1}.

starttls.label: STARTTLS
starttls.help: Upgrade the connection to TLS at this step.

labels.label: Export labels
labels.help: Labels exported on the probe_expect_info metric.

fail_if_matches_regexp.label: Fail if matches regexp
fail_if_matches_regexp.help: Fail if any RR matches one of these regexes.

fail_if_all_match_regexp.label: Fail if all match regexp
fail_if_all_match_regexp.help: Fail if every RR matches one of these regexes.

fail_if_not_matches_regexp.label: Fail if not matches regexp
fail_if_not_matches_regexp.help: Fail if any RR does not match one of these regexes.

fail_if_none_matches_regexp.label: Fail if none matches regexp
fail_if_none_matches_regexp.help: Fail if no RR matches one of these regexes.

http.label: HTTP
http.description: Probe a URL over HTTP/HTTPS. Target example: https://example.com

method.label: Method
method.help: The HTTP method the probe will use.

valid_status_codes.label: Valid status codes
valid_status_codes.help: Accepted status codes. Empty defaults to any 2xx.

valid_http_versions.label: Valid HTTP versions
valid_http_versions.help: Accepted HTTP versions for this probe.

headers.label: Request headers
headers.help: HTTP headers set for the probe.

body.label: Request body
body.help: The body of the HTTP request. Mutually exclusive with body file.

body_file.label: Body file
body_file.help: Read the request body from a file (path inside the blackbox container). Mutually exclusive with body.

fail_if_ssl.label: Fail if SSL
fail_if_ssl.help: Probe fails if SSL is present.

fail_if_not_ssl.label: Fail if not SSL
fail_if_not_ssl.help: Probe fails if SSL is not present.

fail_if_body_not_matches_regexp.label: Fail if body does not match regexp

fail_if_header_not_matches.label: Fail if header does not match

fail_if_body_json_matches_cel.label: Fail if body JSON matches CEL
fail_if_body_json_matches_cel.help: CEL expression evaluated against the JSON response body. Probe fails on match or if response is not JSON.

fail_if_body_json_not_matches_cel.label: Fail if body JSON does not match CEL

ip_protocol_fallback.label: IP protocol fallback
ip_protocol_fallback.help: Allow falling back to the other IP protocol.

compression.label: Compression
compression.help: Algorithm used to decompress the response.

body_size_limit.label: Body size limit
body_size_limit.help: Maximum uncompressed body length processed. 0 means no limit.

enable_http3.label: Enable HTTP/3
enable_http3.help: When enabled, HTTP/2 must be disabled and valid_http_versions must not include HTTP/2.0.

no_proxy.label: No proxy
no_proxy.help: Comma-separated IPs, CIDRs, or domain names excluded from proxying.

proxy_connect_header.label: Proxy CONNECT headers
proxy_connect_header.help: Headers sent to proxies during CONNECT requests.

http_headers.label: http_headers
http_headers.help: Headers from values, secrets, or files. Edit in YAML mode.

tcp.label: TCP
tcp.description: Establish a TCP connection, optionally exchanging payloads. Target example: smtp.example.com:25

query_response.label: Query/response script
query_response.help: Ordered send/expect steps executed after the connection is established.

tls.label: TLS on connect
tls.help: Use TLS when the connection is initiated.

dns.label: DNS
dns.description: Query a DNS server and validate the answer. Target is the DNS server to query, e.g. 1.1.1.1

valid_rcodes.label: Valid rcodes
valid_rcodes.help: List of valid response codes. Default: NOERROR.

recursion_desired.label: Recursion desired
recursion_desired.help: Set the RD flag in the request.

dns_over_tls.label: DNS over TLS
dns_over_tls.help: Only works with the TCP transport protocol.

icmp.label: ICMP
icmp.description: Ping a host via ICMP echo. Target example: 192.168.1.1 — requires NET_RAW or an unprivileged ping range on the blackbox container.

payload_size.label: Payload size
payload_size.help: The size of the ICMP payload in bytes.

dont_fragment.label: Don't fragment
dont_fragment.help: Set the DF bit in the IP header. ip4 only; requires raw sockets (root or CAP_NET_RAW).

ttl.label: TTL
ttl.help: TTL of outbound packets, 0-255. Useful to test reachability within a number of hops.

grpc.label: gRPC
grpc.description: Check a gRPC endpoint via the health checking protocol. Target example: grpc.example.com:443

service.label: Service
service.help: The service name to query for health status. Empty checks overall server health.

tls.label: TLS
tls.help: Connect to the endpoint with TLS.

metadata.label: Client metadata
metadata.help: gRPC client metadata, one or more values per key.

unix.label: Unix socket
unix.description: Probe a Unix domain socket, optionally exchanging payloads. Target example: /run/app/app.sock

query_response.label: Query/response script
query_response.help: Ordered send/expect steps executed after the connection is established.
